evals.name: mixed-two-albums
evals.prompt: I dropped some new photos into the photos-to-add/ folder of this repo. They were all taken at Montrose Point Bird Sanctuary, Chicago, IL. Please add them to the correct albums — compress and convert them properly, and update the album JSON so they show up on the site.
evals.expected_output: 4 photos added to backyards (incl. scta as HDR AVIF) and 3 to warblers (amre/coye deconflicted), P3 preserved, correct species names + location, valid JSON
